race.description: Mrc Membership Made Of Moments 3YO Hcp
race.comment: Keen to see the unbeaten CRUISERWEIGHT (2) go around again. He'd won in good time fresh at Swan Hill and really went on with it here last time, sitting back off a fast tempo and powering down the outside late, again in strong overall time. He's progressive, draws well for Williams and looks the clear horse to beat. MAHERSHALA (6) is a nice type in his own right, also unbeaten in two starts in Australia. He was ridden more positively at Sandown Lakeside last time and came away to win well. This is a decent step up but he gets in well after the claim and should measure up. CELTICS (5) tried to go with CRUISERWEIGHT here last time and tried hard in second. Not sure he can turn the tables but he's right in the mix. LUDLUM (11) was poor in the Creswick Stakes last time but had been coming along nicely prior and could improve for the top yard.
